title: A Governance-Aware Large Language Model Orchestrated Agentic Digital Twin for Transmission System Operator Control Room Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2609.22476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transmission system operators face rising complexity from renewable integration, reduced inertia, and tighter security margins. Large language models offer natural-language decision support, but their hallucinations, uncontrolled tool use, and weak traceability conflict with control room requirements. This paper presents a governance-aware agentic digital twin for transmission grid control rooms. The large language model only selects and parameterizes whitelisted analysis tools, and every proposed action passes through a governance layer that the model cannot bypass. The layer enforces four rules on every run. Only whitelisted tools execute. No run exceeds its step budget. No action with side effects executes without explicit operator approval. Every number in an answer is rendered by the layer from backend results with its unit, variable, and time. The rules are checked on a persistent audit trail for every run of a released 118-task be

translated_title: 面向输电系统运营商控制室决策支持的治理感知大语言模型编排智能体数字孪生
translated_abstract: 输电系统运营商面临着可再生能源并网、系统惯量降低以及安全裕度收紧所带来的日益增长的复杂性。大语言模型能够提供自然语言决策支持，但其幻觉问题、不受控的工具使用以及较弱的追溯性与控制室的要求相冲突。本文提出了一种面向输电网控制室的治理感知智能体数字孪生。大语言模型仅负责选择和参数化白名单中的分析工具，且每一项提议的操作都必须经过模型无法绕过的治理层。该层在每次运行中强制执行四条规则：仅白名单中的工具可以执行；任何运行不得超过其步骤预算；任何具有副作用的行为未经操作员明确批准不得执行；答案中的每一个数字均由该层根据后端结果渲染，并附带其单位、变量和时间。这些规则在持久化的审计轨迹上进行检查，覆盖已发布的118个任务基准的每次运行……
tldr: 本文提出一种治理感知的智能体数字孪生框架，让大语言模型仅能调用白名单分析工具，且所有操作均需通过模型无法绕过的治理层强制约束（包括步骤预算、操作员审批和数值溯源），从而为输电网控制室提供安全、可审计的决策支持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a governance-aware agentic digital twin in which the LLM can only select and parameterize whitelisted tools, and every action passes through an unbypassable governance layer enforcing step budgets, explicit operator approval, and full number provenance, enabling safe and auditable decision support for transmission control rooms.
